AdversarialVerify.head: 0b4447e5bfbed4a72e4b741933698f3f3f7d3b8c
AdversarialVerify.reason: All five original findings are corrected, but the generated Console and Stage workers now call skipWaiting() and clients.claim(). A real active-session update immediately replaced each controller instead of waiting, violating the required service-worker update deferral and active-session build pinning. The shipped headed runtime validator also hung until the external 360-second deadline.

original_findings.evidence: After clearing HTTP cache, closing headed Chrome, stopping both origins and cold-restarting the same profile, both applications rendered nonblank. Hashed JS and CSS each returned status 200 with fromServiceWorker=true.
A matching FOREIGN_CACHE_CANARY response in a foreign cache did not render online or through the cold app-scoped fallback. Generated workers contain no global caches.match call.

Console and Stage dev and preview responses carried frame-ancestors 'none'; deployment _headers artifacts matched. Headed Chrome rejected an evil.localhost iframe and emitted the expected CSP console violation.
Every computed animation duration/delay and transition duration/delay was <=1ms on Console and Stage. .ui-reveal computed animation-duration was 0.001s.

Document width and height equaled the viewport, no required control rectangle was clipped, and no scrollbar appeared at 1440x900, 768x900, 320x800, 720x450/DPR2 or physical fullscreen. Decorative transformed content retains 5-7px hidden-container scroll geometry but stays inside the physical viewport and clips no control.

blocking_findings.finding: Both generated workers call self.skipWaiting() during install and self.clients.claim() during activate. Registering /sw.js?qa-active-session-update=1 caused controllerchange once and immediately changed active/controller from /sw.js to the update URL on both Console and Stage; no waiting worker remained.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Remove unconditional skipWaiting/clients.claim from active presentation sessions and preserve the new release in waiting until an explicit session-safe activation boundary.

blocking_findings.finding: BROWSER_HEADED=true bun run check:browser-runtime printed through 'Installing console offline shell...' and then made no progress before the external 360-second timeout. The independent headed runner completed, so this is the shipped validator rather than a Chrome capability limitation.
